function: above_phy, p. 7: "The task offloading decision is determined using a Q-learning algorithm." Transmit power and CPU frequency are not learned but solved by an interior point method (p. 6).
notes: Title and DOI 10.1109/JIOT.2024.3398055 on p. 1 match the work. Satellite-assisted IoT network (LEO edge server, GEO relay to a ground cloud) minimizing a weighted latency and energy cost. The MTRL method has two tiers, p. 5: "The first tier optimizes the CPU operating frequency and transmission power through the model-assisted mechanisms. The second tier utilizes the Q-learning algorithm"; the first tier is classical, p. 6: "Using the interior point method (IPM) [25], [26] to assist solution". The Q-table actions are only the offloading modes local, edge, cloud (p. 7: "the agent takes action A as task offloading decision"; p. 8: "a total of 243 actions" for five devices). No physical-layer decision is learned, so the satellite exception for learned power or resource control does not apply. Not no_learning, since the proposed method is learned (Q-learning) and acts on task offloading, above the physical layer. Baselines FEC, FCC, simulated annealing; metric system cost (p. 8, p. 10).
